headline: Beyond views,
towards trust.
summary: 30 comments on 4 videos, in 5 languages. More than 1 in 3 is a question nobody has answered yet: that's your next 8 videos and your warmest leads.

highlight.title: of comments are questions, and none has an answer yet
highlight.text: 11 of 30 comments ask something: which drill, which glue, how to start from zero. Every one is a ready-made video idea or a future student. ReplyDNA drafted an answer for all 11, each in the viewer's own language.
highlight.foot: Demo data: 30 fictional comments on 4 videos, last 30 days.

cards.comment_quote: Pocket holes are for people who can't cut proper joinery. Real woodworkers use dovetails.
cards.draft_reply: Dovetails are beautiful and I'd love to film a series on them. Pocket holes just get beginners building this weekend instead of someday.
cards.option_b: Real woodworkers finish projects 😄 Dovetails are on the list, but first-timers need a win before a masterpiece.
